globalAnalysis.visualFlow: Two upright figures balance a dark interior around their joined hands, while the mirror, chandelier, dog, window, and garments create precise symbolic detail.
globalAnalysis.curatorialNote: Human motifs should remain formal and restrained; architectural objects create measured pulses, while the dog and fabric introduce warmer organic movement.

cells.label: Window and timbered ceiling
cells.interpretation: Hard window and ceiling lines establish the enclosed domestic space.

cells.label: Merchant's hat and chandelier edge
cells.interpretation: The dark hat frames the still face beneath the ordered ceiling.

cells.label: Chandelier and written wall
cells.interpretation: Small precise objects hang and radiate around the room's symbolic center.

cells.label: Bride beneath the red canopy
cells.interpretation: The pale veiled head is held against the deep red vertical bed.

cells.label: Merchant's raised gesture
cells.interpretation: A restrained raised hand introduces a formal speaking or witnessing gesture.

cells.label: Dark robe approaching the vow
cells.interpretation: The dark figure extends quietly toward the joined hands.

cells.label: Joined hands and convex mirror
cells.interpretation: The joined hands align with the mirror as the ceremonial focus of the room.

cells.label: Bride's torso and red chamber
cells.interpretation: The bride's hand rests over the broad green dress against the red interior.

cells.label: Merchant's long dark robe
cells.interpretation: The nearly unbroken robe creates a slow grave vertical mass.

cells.label: Robe beside the carved chair
cells.interpretation: Soft cloth and rigid furniture divide the dim interior.

cells.label: Green ceremonial dress
cells.interpretation: Rich green folds descend with controlled weight and organic depth.

cells.label: Dress and red curtain edge
cells.interpretation: Two strong hanging fabrics create a formal vertical cadence.

cells.label: Pattens and merchant's feet
cells.interpretation: Scattered footwear punctuates the measured wooden floor.

cells.label: Loyal dog between the couple
cells.interpretation: The alert textured dog warms the still formal space between the figures.

cells.label: Dog at the green hem
cells.interpretation: The dog's irregular fur meets the broad descending garment.

cells.label: Green train resting on the floor
cells.interpretation: The green train spreads outward and settles into the room's lower edge.
